existing_value: The most planted red, strongest in Velkopavlovická.
problem: Sources disagree on "most planted red": the Wine Fund page calls Saint Laurent "our most widespread and most cultivated blue variety", while the National Wine Centre area figures put Frankovka (861 ha) ahead of Svatovavřinecké (690 ha). It is also a planted area ranking, which the round 4 style rules avoid.

Spelling check only: the Tokaj specification lists the permitted variety as "Sárgamuskotály" (one word, section VI) and also writes "Sárga Muskotály" (section VII); Wines of Hungary uses "Sárgamuskotály". Both forms appear on labels; not a contradiction.

Spelling check only: the Somló and Badacsony specifications write the variety as "Olasz rizling" (two words); Wines of Hungary writes "Olaszrizling". Current value matches common label use; not a contradiction.
